## Who it is for

Engineers, managers and executives of industrial companies who want a concrete view of what AI can do for their operations.

## Content

Industrial use cases of AI — **quality, maintenance, cost estimation, planning** — built on real cases from my work with manufacturing SMEs: what each use case requires in terms of data, skills and organisation, what it costs, and what it brings.

## Format

Two days, delivered by Grenoble INP's professional training department, inter- or intra-company.
